verdict.rationale: Sentry ships its own AI agent (Seer), so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence shows Sentry acting as an MCP client. The pack covers only adjacent capabilities that earn no credit here: Sentry's official MCP server, which exposes Sentry to other assistants (server role), MCP server monitoring and tracing (observability), and handoffs from Seer to Cursor and Copilot coding agents.
